Sonobuoy

A sonobuoy is a buoy used to detect underwater sounds.

Passive operation

A passive sonobuoy lowers a hydrophone into the water. It listens for sound from submarines without emitting a sonar pulse.[1]

The passive sonobuoy transmits the hydrophone signals by radio to an aircraft. Operators use these signals to detect and locate underwater sound sources.

Active operation

Active sonar emits a pulse and listens for returning echoes.
